montu-mia.title: Montu Mia's System Design
montu-mia.description: Making complex system design concepts simple for everyone. 2,000+ subscribers, 20,000+ readers.
montu-mia.longDescription: A weekly system design book published as a LinkedIn newsletter and website, explaining complex system design fundamentals in Bengali through storytelling. Follows the journey of a character named Montu Mia building a video platform, covering topics like scaling, load balancers, networking protocols, caching, and CDNs. Built with a full-stack infrastructure including automated email newsletters, dynamic OG image generation, and a documentation site.
features: Weekly system design chapters in Bengali
Automated email newsletter delivery via AWS SES
Dynamic OG image generation for social sharing
Interactive documentation site with dark/light themes
challenges: Building an automated newsletter pipeline with AWS SES and React Email
Generating dynamic Open Graph images for each chapter
Making complex system design concepts accessible through Bengali storytelling
Building a documentation site with Fumadocs and MDX
impact: 2,000+ subscribers across website and LinkedIn newsletter
Making system design education accessible in Bengali

ramble.title: Ramble
ramble.description: Your network, pooled-in. An app to transcribe meetings, extract commitments, and take notes using voice with AI.
ramble.longDescription: Ramble is an application to transcribe meetings, get overheard commitments, and follow up from meetings — taking notes using voice with the help of AI. It helps teams capture, organize, and act on meeting insights automatically.
features: Automatic commitment and action item extraction
challenges: Built a conversational platform enabling users to search and engage with contacts using RAG and LLM technologies.
Developed a feature for document-based conversations and summary generation leveraging Python-based tools.
Designed and implemented a rich text editor with real-time collaboration using PlateJS and PubNub.
Built and tested a web application with NextJS, TypeScript, and Playwright for enhanced user experience.

avro-silicon.title: Avro Silicon
avro-silicon.description: Avro phonetic keyboard modernized for Apple Silicon Macs with native performance
avro-silicon.longDescription: Avro Silicon is a modernized version of the popular Avro phonetic Bengali keyboard, rebuilt for Apple Silicon (M-series) Macs. It brings native performance and compatibility to the most widely used Bengali phonetic typing tool on macOS.
challenges: Modernizing legacy Objective-C codebase for Apple Silicon
Working with macOS Input Method Kit for system-level keyboard integration
Ensuring compatibility across macOS versions
impact: Enabling Bengali typing on modern Macs
Serving the Bengali-speaking macOS user community

vocables.title: Vocables
vocables.description: AI-powered vocabulary learning platform that helps you build and retain new words
vocables.longDescription: Vocables is an AI-powered vocabulary learning platform designed to help users build and retain new words effectively. It leverages AI to create personalized learning experiences and help users expand their vocabulary.
challenges: Designing effective AI-driven vocabulary learning flows
Building engaging and retention-focused learning experiences
impact: Helping users expand their vocabulary with AI assistance

profreach.title: Profreach
profreach.description: Professor outreach platform to help students connect with professors for higher studies
profreach.longDescription: Profreach is a platform designed to streamline the process of reaching out to professors for higher studies. It helps students find, organize, and manage their outreach to potential academic advisors.
challenges: Building an intuitive interface for managing professor outreach
Organizing and tracking communication across multiple professors
impact: Simplifying the professor outreach process for students pursuing higher studies

trak.title: trak
trak.description: A simple, fast analytics tool built with Rust for lightweight traffic tracking
trak.longDescription: trak is a lightweight analytics tool built in Rust, designed for developers who want simple, fast, and privacy-respecting traffic tracking without the overhead of complex analytics platforms.
challenges: Building a performant analytics tool in Rust
Designing a minimal yet useful analytics interface
impact: Providing a lightweight alternative to bloated analytics tools

coterm.title: Coterm
coterm.description: Copilot for your terminal built with Rust, Vercel edge functions, and OpenAI API
coterm.longDescription: Coterm is a terminal copilot that bridges the gap between natural language and command-line interfaces. Built with Rust for performance and integrated with OpenAI's API, it allows developers to describe what they want to do in plain English and receive the exact command they need.
features: Natural language to CLI command generation
Safety measures and dangerous command detection
challenges: Generate CLI commands using natural language
Revise generated command
Run command using one key press
Vercel edge function to connect to OpenAI API
impact: 10-15 minutes daily time savings for users

resume.title: Re:sume
resume.description: Web application to create and enhance resumes using AI with PDF generation and OpenAI integration
resume.longDescription: Re:sume is an AI-powered resume builder that helps professionals create compelling resumes. It uses advanced AI to enhance content, suggest improvements, and generate polished PDF outputs tailored for specific job applications.
features: AI-powered content enhancement with OpenAI GPT
challenges: AI prompt engineering for resume content
PDF layout and formatting
User experience optimization

bochon.title: Bochon
bochon.description: Bengali speech-to-text model comparison platform developed for Bengali.ai
bochon.longDescription: Bochon is a comprehensive performance dashboard developed for Bengali.ai to showcase and compare various Bengali Speech-to-Text models. It provides detailed analytics, benchmarks, and interactive demonstrations of different ASR models.
challenges: Real-time audio processing
Model performance visualization
Responsive design for complex data
